title: Maa Inti Bangaaram
tagline: Samantha shines in a warm family drama that stumbles in its bigger moments.
verdict: Samantha and Nandini Reddy's eye for household detail carry a film that stumbles in its flashback and climax.

title: Dhamaal 4
tagline: Loud, cheerful, instantly forgettable — save it for OTT.
verdict: A harmless one-time watch — save it for OTT, and only when your hands are busy with something else.
